intent: Settings page blueprint: header, grouped fields, and save/cancel actions.
doNot: Do not restyle Field or Input inside the pattern
Do not invent local form layouts
Do not skip Field wrappers on labeled inputs
Do not add more than one primary Button
Do not invent a padded app shell or a narrow-screen menu. Render this pattern as the children of AppShellPattern (app-shell): AppHeader over SideNav when wide, Menu Button + left Drawer below 64rem.
